changes: DMG raster effects are cleaner: mid-line palette changes now match the reference hardware more closely, reducing misplaced colour bands in wipes, status bars and scene transitions.
DMG reference-picture matching improved from 92.9402% to 94.1665% (+1.23 percentage points, +1.32% relative).
A short live scanline can no longer reveal pixels left over from the previous row, so palette and window effects stay visually continuous.
Six representative games kept identical frame/CPU checksums; available browser headroom measured +1.65% at the median (1.12%–3.08% per game).
The complete project suite remains green, with no conformance timeouts. v3.0 stays reserved for broader revision-aware accuracy work.
